question: Quantos pedidos existem no total?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS pedidos FROM orders

question: Quantos clientes únicos fizeram pedidos?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_unique_id) AS clientes FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id

question: Quantos pedidos foram entregues?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS pedidos FROM orders WHERE order_status = 'delivered'

question: Quantos pedidos existem em cada status?
gold_sql: SELECT order_status, COUNT(*) AS pedidos FROM orders GROUP BY order_status

question: Quais as 5 categorias de produto com maior faturamento?
gold_sql: SELECT p.product_category_name, ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS faturamento FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' GROUP BY p.product_category_name ORDER BY faturamento DESC LIMIT 5

question: Qual o faturamento total, sem frete?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS faturamento FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'

question: Qual o valor total de frete dos pedidos entregues?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.freight_value), 2) AS frete FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'

question: Quais os 5 estados com mais clientes únicos?
gold_sql: SELECT customer_state, COUNT(DISTINCT customer_unique_id) AS clientes FROM customers GROUP BY customer_state ORDER BY clientes DESC LIMIT 5

question: Quais os 5 estados com mais vendedores?
gold_sql: SELECT seller_state, COUNT(*) AS vendedores FROM sellers GROUP BY seller_state ORDER BY vendedores DESC LIMIT 5

question: Qual a nota média das avaliações, com 2 casas decimais?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(review_score), 2) AS nota_media FROM reviews

question: Quantas avaliações existem para cada nota?
gold_sql: SELECT review_score, COUNT(*) AS avaliacoes FROM reviews GROUP BY review_score

question: Quantos pedidos foram feitos em cada mês de 2017?
gold_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', order_purchase_timestamp) AS mes, COUNT(*) AS pedidos FROM orders WHERE strftime('%Y', order_purchase_timestamp) = '2017' GROUP BY mes ORDER BY mes

question: Considerando todos os pedidos, qual o valor médio pago por pedido?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(total), 2) AS valor_medio FROM (SELECT order_id, SUM(payment_value) AS total FROM payments GROUP BY order_id)

question: Quantos pagamentos existem por tipo de pagamento?
gold_sql: SELECT payment_type, COUNT(*) AS pagamentos FROM payments GROUP BY payment_type

question: Qual a média de parcelas nos pagamentos com cartão de crédito, com 2 casas decimais?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(payment_installments), 2) AS parcelas_media FROM payments WHERE payment_type = 'credit_card'

question: Qual o tempo médio de entrega, em dias, entre a compra e a entrega ao cliente? Use 2 casas decimais.
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(julianday(order_delivered_customer_date) - julianday(order_purchase_timestamp)), 2) AS dias FROM orders WHERE order_status = 'delivered' AND order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL

question: Quantos pedidos entregues chegaram depois da data estimada de entrega?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS atrasados FROM orders WHERE order_status = 'delivered' AND order_delivered_customer_date > order_estimated_delivery_date
SELECT COUNT(*) AS atrasados FROM orders WHERE order_status = 'delivered' AND date(order_delivered_customer_date) > date(order_estimated_delivery_date)

question: Qual a nota média das avaliações de pedidos entregues com atraso e sem atraso? Use 2 casas decimais.
gold_sql: SELECT CASE WHEN o.order_delivered_customer_date > o.order_estimated_delivery_date THEN 'atrasado' ELSE 'no prazo' END AS situacao, ROUND(AVG(r.review_score), 2) AS nota_media FROM orders o JOIN reviews r ON r.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' AND o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL GROUP BY situacao

SELECT CASE WHEN date(o.order_delivered_customer_date) > date(o.order_estimated_delivery_date) THEN 'atrasado' ELSE 'no prazo' END AS situacao, ROUND(AVG(r.review_score), 2) AS nota_media FROM orders o JOIN reviews r ON r.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' AND o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL GROUP BY situacao

question: Quais os 5 vendedores com maior faturamento? Mostre o seller_id e o valor.
gold_sql: SELECT oi.seller_id, ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS faturamento FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' GROUP BY oi.seller_id ORDER BY faturamento DESC LIMIT 5

question: Quais as 10 cidades de clientes com mais pedidos?
gold_sql: SELECT c.customer_city, COUNT(*) AS pedidos FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_city ORDER BY pedidos DESC LIMIT 10

question: Qual a categoria, com o nome em inglês, que mais vendeu em número de itens?
gold_sql: SELECT t.product_category_name_english, COUNT(*) AS itens FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN category_translation t ON t.product_category_name = p.product_category_name WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' GROUP BY t.product_category_name_english ORDER BY itens DESC LIMIT 1

question: Qual o faturamento de cada ano?
gold_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y', o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS ano, ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS faturamento FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' GROUP BY ano ORDER BY ano

question: Qual o peso médio, em gramas, dos produtos da categoria moveis_decoracao? Use 2 casas decimais.
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(product_weight_g), 2) AS peso_medio FROM products WHERE product_category_name = 'moveis_decoracao'

question: Quantos clientes compraram mais de uma vez?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS clientes FROM (SELECT c.customer_unique_id FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) > 1)

question: Qual o item mais caro já vendido? Mostre o product_id e o preço.
gold_sql: SELECT product_id, price FROM order_items ORDER BY price DESC LIMIT 1
